To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the weak pose representation of the 3D pose data is a compact pose representation, (b) the BOP model is more effective than the standard Bag of Words pipeline for HAR and (c) the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.

1) weak poses are a compact and discriminative representation of 3D pose data, 2) the proposed BOP model is more efficient and robust than the standard bag of words model, and 3) weak poses are useful in action recognition, and they can be used to improve the performance of the standard bag of features model for HAR.

(1) we propose a novel human pose representation, weak poses, in a low dimensional space while keeping most discriminative information; and (2) we present a novel Bag of Poses model that uses weak poses to improve human action recognition
